value.rationale: A continuum of interior equilibria creates a natural nonhyperbolic selection problem in a recent parity-transition model: local shift stability does not establish that every positive solution remains uniformly persistent or avoids competing attractors. The theorem supplies a globally quantitated convergence regime, a unique explicitly selected limiting equilibrium, an exponential tail, and an exact algebraic threshold beyond which no positive diagonal entropy certificate of this natural form can work. The threshold is motivated by the degeneracy and is not offered as a dynamical bifurcation.
